translations.web: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
translations.bsb: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
translations.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
translations.asv: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
